ValidationRule.description: Restrict 'Date Received' field so it cannot occur AFTER the 'Date/Time Opened' field
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Systemic_Issue', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'General_Inquiry_CMOS' ), (DATETIMEVALUE(( IDR_Date_Received__c)) > CreatedDate) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Date Received cannot occur after the Date/ Time Opened
